title: Group Buy campaign-options contract
description: Versioned JSON contract describing WHAT MAY BE SOLD in a Group Buy campaign (docs/SLICE-2-AND-GROUP-BUY-OWNER-DECISIONS.md §12, locked 2026-09-19). Structural validation only — the authoritative validator is app/app/domain/groupbuy/campaignOptions.ts, which additionally (1) recursively refuses any forbidden pricing key anywhere in the document, by name, and (2) cross-checks validCombinations/tableView/orderingFlow against the declared option dimensions, both of which are beyond what plain JSON Schema can express. Every object below is CLOSED (additionalProperties: false) specifically so an unrecognised key — margin, uplift, a pricing-rule id, anything — is already rejected at the schema layer, not only by the TypeScript validator.

schemaVersion.description: Versioned from the start (§12): a campaign published today must remain readable when the format changes. Extend the enum for a new version; never reinterpret an old one's meaning.

productType.description: Free text — "ring", "bracelet", "necklace", or any future product type. Never a fixed enum: §11 requires that nothing ring-shaped is hard-coded.

optionDimensions.description: Campaign-specific option dimensions (§11) — metal, length, clasp, stone size, or anything else this product actually varies by. No fixed set.

validCombinations.description: Every purchasable configuration (§11: invalid combinations must not be purchasable). "values" keys/values are validated against optionDimensions by the TypeScript validator, not by this schema — a closed additionalProperties would defeat the whole point of a campaign-chosen key set.

tableView.description: Public comparison-table configuration (README §10). No price column — the table shows the Regular/Card Price, computed and rendered elsewhere, never carried in this contract.

orderingFlow.description: The sequence of option dimensions presented while a customer chooses a configuration.
